source_refs.note: Exercise 6.1, Question 9: circle with centre (5, 0) through the meeting point of two lines; book p. 173, answers p. 304 (PDF 306)

blocks.prompt: 9. Find the equation of the circle passing through the point of intersection of the lines \(x - y - 5 = 0\), \(2x + y - 4 = 0\) and it has its centre at \((5, 0)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan centre seedha diya hua hai, sirf radius chahiye. Radius ke liye circle ka koi ek point kaafi hai.
Diya kya hai? Centre \((5, 0)\), aur circle do lines ke milne wale point se guzarta hai.
Find kya karna hai? Circle ki equation.
Rule kaunsa? Do lines ka point of intersection simultaneous equations se, phir distance formula.
Plan: point nikalo, us ka centre se faasla radius, phir standard form.
steps:
Diya gaya: centre \((5, 0)\); circle \(x - y - 5 = 0\) aur \(2x + y - 4 = 0\) ke intersection point se guzarta hai.
Maloom karna: equation.
Tareeqa: Dono lines ko saath hal kar ke point nikalenge; centre se us point ka faasla radius hoga; phir standard form.

Point of intersection
\[(x - y - 5) + (2x + y - 4) = 0\]
\[3x - 9 = 0,\quad x = 3\]
\[y = x - 5 = -2\]
Kyun: Ek mein \(-y\) aur doosri mein \(+y\) hai, jama karne se \(y\) ud gaya. Phir pehli line se \(y = 3 - 5 = -2\).

Radius
\[r^2 = (3 - 5)^2 + (-2 - 0)^2 = 8\]
Kyun: Centre \((5, 0)\) se point \((3, -2)\) tak distance formula. \(r^2\) hi chahiye tha, is liye root lene ki zaroorat nahi.
Dhyan dein: Standard form mein \(r^2\) aata hai; \(r = 2\sqrt{2}\) nikal kar dobara square karna faltu kaam hai.

Tasdeeq
\[(3, -2):\ 9 + 4 - 30 + 17 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Intersection point circle par hai. Radius \(\sqrt{8} = 2\sqrt{2}\) hai.
